snack-bot: Reminder: Please label food items with allergens. See pantry rules in #help.
Nora: great. if you can bring booze, please mark on the sheet so we can keep totals. otherwise mocktail options are welcome. quick sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1MimosaShare (col A name, B item, C alcohol? Y/N, D allergies)
Ben: :thumbsup: i'll put down prosecco x2 and help set up at 10:30.
Talia: :thumbsup: adding pastries and OJ.
